links.text: "I will drive the orcs away for you farmers."

As I told you, kill the turek orcs and bring their necklaces back as proof, and I will give you a reward. Also, do not discard the ancient relics that the orcs keep with them. Collect them all. Q00422_RepentYourSins/30597-01.html.text: Piotur: Are you here to hunt the Turek war hounds ? A while back a black-clad sage appeared and told me that someone like you was coming and I should ask for help with my needs. When the war was over I returned to find my farm devastated by the filthy orcs! I hired mercenaries and managed to drive …

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30597-02.html.text: Piotur: I'm beginning to think that those damned Turek war hounds are worse that the Turek orcs themselves. Not long ago I was attacked by one and nearly lost my leg! Please go and hunt 10 of them down at the Orc Barracks . You don't need to bring those filthy animals' corpses back here, just cut o…

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30597-03.html.text: Piotur: That was quick! Well done! Most mercenaries demand payment in advance... Is it possible you were sent by the gods? Well, you are an angel to me, anyway... I truly have never met anyone as kind and virtuous as you!

Q00422_RepentYourSins/30597-04.html.text: Piotur: Oh, it's you! Thanks to you, my farm is peaceful again. Come back after the fruit ripens and we'll have a drink together!

Q00221_TestimonyOfProsperity/30597-02.ht.text: Piotur: Hope..., Yes, I suppose there is hope after all... These days the hired troops are taking care of the Orcs while my brothers and I work day and night to reclaim the land. Someday this farm will boast the richest land in the kingdom of Aden! So you seek the Token of the Fertile Lands ? Then …

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30597-06.html.text: Piotur: I am sad to see you go, but it seems that our fates which brought us together for a time now must separate. However, only the gods know the destiny of people. I may request your help again someday. Or a day may come when I will help you ... we never know. May the goddess' blessing be upon y…

Q00327_RecoverTheFarmland/30597-07.html.text: Piotur: They say that the turek orcs have trained the ferocious wolves to use as military hounds. Even the smallest creature knows its master. When orcs are attacked, the wolves fight as well, so be careful. May the goddess' blessing be with you.
